snippet.title: Cyber City Escape Game Trailer 2020
snippet.description:
Cyber City Escape is a 3D topdown roguelite shooter set in a cyberpunk world. The game features procedurally generated maps, fog of war fueled exploration, multiple weapon types, multiple enemy types, environmental hazards and traps, equipment kiosks to buy gear, permanent progression and more.

Steam Link - https://store.steampowered.com/app/986790/Cyber_City_Escape/
